text: Unlike a standard ESN, NVAR has no transient reservoir state to discard, so it needs no reservoir ___ before prediction can begin.
explanation: Because the features are a direct function of the current and past inputs, prediction can start as soon as k+1 samples are available — there is no initial-condition transient to wash out. Eliminating the washout/warm-up (and hyperparameters like ρ that govern it) is a hallmark advantage of NVAR over the ESN.
